name: @claudekit/ui
description: Shared React components for claudeKit hosts (reports, settings, transcripts).
//: These components are consumed by SOURCE from each host's bundler, so nothing is built here. The dependencies exist purely so TypeScript can resolve React when a host typechecks files at this path: without a node_modules alongside them, tsc walking up from ui/src finds nothing and every JSX tag collapses into an implicit-any cascade in the HOST's build.
//deps: Real dependencies, installed HERE. Hosts bundle these components from source, and both Vite and tsc resolve their bare imports by walking up from this directory — verified: HomeFlix builds against them without installing anything, and its bundle still contains exactly one React copy. react is a devDependency only (types + resolution); it must never be installed as a real one or a host would bundle two React instances and every hook in these components would break.
